Description.header: Allocates a staging directory and ingests its completed files concurrently.
Description.body: Copy a directory tree into the returned input directory. Each status FIFO emits JSON Lines progress for one worker; the result FIFO returns the aggregate result after the staging tree is idle and drained.
Description.footer: Only regular, single-link files are accepted. Paths are recreated below destination/preferred_directory and existing paths are never overwritten.
